channel.title: Wire — Rust
channel.description: Rust from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Be alert: targeted attacks on prominent Rustaceans
item.description: We believe that there is an ongoing campaign targeting rust-lang members and owners of popular crates that is attempting to compromise devices and accounts in order to use them to publish malware. (4 sources: golangweekly, lobsters, rprogramming, rustblog)

item.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)
item.description: Cloudflare's global network is immense but not limitless. As we look for small ways to trim our resource usage, we sometimes get lucky and we can cut significantly more. (2 sources: cloudflare, lobsters)
